CustomField.description: Body exactly as received, stored verbatim because the HMAC is computed over the raw bytes - reserialising changes whitespace and key order and invalidates the signature. Populated ONLY for deliveries whose signature verified: an unverified body is dropped and replaced by a size and digest fingerprint in Error_Message__c, so an anonymous caller cannot use this endpoint as a large write primitive. GUEST-SENSITIVE: carries reporter and assignee PII from Jira.
CustomField.label: Raw Payload
